title: Paste & Taste: API status
description: Whether the Paste & Taste API is answering, and in which environment.
heading: API status
apiError: The API answered with an error. Try again in a few minutes.
unreachable: The API cannot be reached right now. Try again in a few minutes.
notFoundBody: There is no page at this address.
errorBody: This page could not be shown. Try again in a moment.
showcaseDescription: Every piece of the interface, in every state.
showcaseIntro: Each piece in each of its states. To see the focus ring, move through the page with the Tab key, or tap a text field.
showcaseFormNote: The three boxes are in a form: sending it adds the ticked ones to the address.
showcaseEmailHint: We send you a code to sign in.
showcaseEmailError: Write a valid email address, like name@example.com.
showcaseCardBody: A card holds one thing: a recipe, a group, a message.
signInDescription: Sign in to Paste & Taste with a code sent to your email, or with a passkey.
signInEmailHint: We send you a 6-digit code to sign in.
signInSpam: If you can't find it, look in your spam folder.
signInResendHint: You can ask for another code a minute after the last one.
signInPasskeyHeading: Or sign in with a passkey
signInPasskeyOfferBody: A passkey lets you sign in with this device's fingerprint, face or screen lock, with no code to wait for. The key stays on your device; we keep only a public part that can't sign anyone in without it. You can still sign in with a code whenever you like.
signInPasskeyAdded: Your passkey is ready. Next time you can sign in with it.
signInErrorInvalidEmail: Write a valid email address, like name@example.com.
signInErrorTooManyCodes: You've asked for too many codes. Wait a few minutes and try again.
signInErrorWrongCode: The code isn't right or has expired. Check it, or ask for another.
signInErrorTooMany: Too many tries from this connection. Wait a while and try again.
signInErrorUnreachable: We can't sign you in right now. Try again in a few minutes.
signInErrorTooSoon: Wait a minute before asking for another code.
signInErrorStartAgain: Too much time has passed. Write your email and we'll send you a new code.
signInErrorPasskeyFailed: The passkey couldn't be used. Try again, or sign in with a code.
signInErrorPasskeyNotCreated: The passkey couldn't be created. Try again, or do it later.
signInErrorCodeNotSent: We couldn't send the code. Try again in a moment.
buildingDescription: Keep the recipes you find on Instagram, YouTube or any web page in your recipe book.
buildingAbout: An app that keeps the recipes you find on Instagram, YouTube or any web page in your recipe book, ready to edit and cook from.
buildingNotOpen: It isn't open yet. Come back later.
recipesDescription: The recipes you keep in Paste & Taste.
recipesEmpty: Put your apron on and write your first recipe.
recipesUnreachable: We can't reach your recipes right now. Check your connection and try again.
recipesApiError: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a few minutes.
recipeDescription: A recipe kept in Paste & Taste.
recipeDeleteWarning: It is deleted for good, with its ingredients and steps. This can't be undone.
recipeDeleteUnreachable: We couldn't delete it. Check your connection and try again.
recipeDeleteApiError: We couldn't delete it: something went wrong on our side. Try again in a few minutes.
newRecipeDescription: Write a recipe by hand in Paste & Taste.
recipeFormSourceHint: A web address, if it has one.
recipeFormIngredientsHint: One ingredient per row. An empty row isn't saved, and Order sets the order.
recipeFormStepsHint: One step per row. An empty row isn't saved, and Order sets the order.
recipeErrorSourceInvalid: Write a web address that starts with https://, like https://example.com/recipe.
recipeErrorIngredientNameMissing: Write this ingredient's name, or clear the row.
recipeErrorRefused: The recipe couldn't be saved. Check the fields.
recipeErrorUnreachable: We couldn't save it. Check your connection and try again.
recipeErrorApiError: We couldn't save it: something went wrong on our side. Try again in a few minutes.
recipeDraftLost: What you typed couldn't be kept.
